richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sasaram

c: Sasaram is the headquarters of Rohtas district in Bihar, and it is best known for the tomb of Sher Shah Suri. Schools, colleges and government offices make up much of the town's institutional land, and that is where many outdoor gyms here are likely to go. FunPlay Systems supplies open gym equipment to Sasaram from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,300 km away.

Government and institutional buyers usually need clear documents before they can approve a purchase. We provide a layout drawing showing every machine and its clear space, along with a quotation listing each item. Once approved, we manufacture the machines, dispatch them by road and install them through our team or a dealer in eastern India. You deal with one contact person at FunPlay from enquiry to handover.

richText.heading: What to prepare before you ask for a quote

items: Measure the length and width of the space and take photos from each corner.
Note the surface, whether soil, grass, concrete or paving.
List who will use the gym, for example students, staff or the public.
Decide whether you want everything at once or in phases.
